entries.summary: 为 TS Runtime 添加本地 Eval CLI，支持从 JSON array 或 JSONL 文件读取 EvalCase fixtures，通过 EvalReplayHarness 顺序 replay，输出 per-case JSONL 结果和 summary，退出码映射 pass/fail 状态。

verification.note: JSON array, JSONL, fail exit code, invalid input, summary
BUILD SUCCESS

notes: CLI is TS Runtime owned
Input supports JSON array and JSONL
Output uses JSONL for per-case results plus summary
CLI exits 0 only when all cases pass

entries.title: Add P5a memory store and eval replay harness
entries.summary: 为 TS Runtime 添加租户/用户隔离的长期记忆存储原语（MemoryStore）和离线 eval replay harness，通过共享 Zod schema 定义 MemoryFact 和 EvalCase 契约，支持 literal search、JSON 持久化、deterministic replay pass/fail 判定。

verification.note: MemoryFactSchema and EvalCaseSchema tests
memory store unit tests
eval replay harness tests

notes: Memory is TS Runtime owned for P5a
P5a uses literal case-insensitive search over content and tags
JSON persistence follows existing JsonFileHistoryStore patterns

entries.title: Add memory management API
entries.summary: P5a/P5b established scoped memory storage and deterministic memory retrieval, but memory facts can only be exercised through internal store APIs and tests. Add an explicit TS Runtime API under /api/v1/memory/facts to list, search, upsert, and delete scoped memory facts.

verification.note: Verified memory search, upsert, and delete schemas under various payloads.
Verified scoped listing, header tenant extraction, IDOR deletion prevention, and tag search filters.
All 250 tests passed successfully.

next: Online memory context building and retrieval (P5b)
notes: Operations require X-Tenant-Id and X-User-Id request headers
Request payload tenant/user attributes are filtered out to prevent tenant bypasses

entries.title: Add P5b memory context retrieval
entries.summary: P5a added scoped long-term memory storage and eval replay, but online agent turns still cannot read memory facts. Add a deterministic memory retrieval layer in the Agent Runtime context builder.

entries.title: Add Tool Protocol
entries.summary: OpenHarness tool catalog currently exposes business tools only. Add a tool protocol classification to shared ToolDefinition, add Java catalog entries for read_file, search, and run_command with bounded output and workspace path containment.

entries.title: Add Prompt Registry
entries.summary: Agent Runtime currently sends conversation messages without a versioned system prompt owned by the harness. Add a TS Runtime prompt registry with versioned prompt templates.

entries.title: Add ContextBuilder Pipeline
entries.summary: Model calls currently use the full stable conversation history and only apply cache hints after that selection. Add an Agent Runtime ContextBuilder that constructs model-call messages from explicit layers with configurable token budget.

verification.note: Verified request schema context metadata parser succeeds.
Verified multi-layer chronological context selection, memory system insertion, budget thresholding, and oversized newest message fallback.
All 250 tests passed successfully.

notes: MODEL_CONTEXT_BUDGET_TOKENS environment variable overrides the 8000 token default
Summary layer and memory layer are loaded with higher precedence than recent messages

entries.title: Add Prompt Injection Guard For Tool Results
entries.summary: Tool results are currently serialized directly into model-visible role:tool messages. Add tool result provenance, boundary wrapping, and policy escalation for untrusted tool output.

verification.note: Shared schema parsed provenance and policy contexts successfully.
Tested XML wrapping of untrusted tool output, untrusted state detection, and policy escalation.
Tested sensitive/destructive tools require approval under untrusted contexts while safe tools are allowed.
All 250 tests passed successfully.

next: Audit metadata/trace attributes for injection guard state
notes: MCP tool results default to untrusted
Java catalog tools default to trusted
Only sensitive/destructive tools are upgraded to require approval, safe tools bypass the guard

entries.title: Add cost tracking and model router
entries.summary: 当前 Java ModelGatewayController 对所有请求使用硬编码的单一 provider。新增 ModelRouter 配置段支持按 model 名称映射 to provider，填充 costUsdMicros 字段以支持 per-tenant 计费和预算告警。

verification.note: Verified model name resolution, fallback routing, and USD micro token multiplications.
Verified cost parameter propagation in runner messages.
All 250 tests passed successfully.

next: Operator budgets and daily rate limits enforcement
Logical intent based logical routing mappings
nonGoals: Java ModelRouter dynamic config hot reload
TS Runtime direct model routing configurations
notes: Unconfigured pricing maps gracefully return null cost metadata
Supports ZHIPU_API_KEY with legacy SENSENOVA_API_KEY configuration fallbacks

entries.title: Execution lifecycle and stream recovery
entries.summary: 当前 Agent Runtime SSE 路径在多个稳定性维度上存在 gap，根因是 HTTP 连接生命周期与 agent execution 生命周期被错误耦合。解决断线恢复、审批不可恢复、HistoryStore 污染、同会话并发未定义、terminal 错误不可观测等 6 类问题。
notes: 此 change 对应 4 个 phase 的 superpowers plan（phase-1 至 phase-4）

entries.title: Policy MCP-aware default decision
entries.summary: P2a 集成 MCP 后引入安全 gap：Java PolicyService 对未知工具默认返回 ALLOW，MCP 工具因不在 Java catalog 中永远落入默认放行分支。让 evaluatePolicy 接受工具来源信号，针对 MCP 来源工具改变默认决策为 REQUIRE_APPROVAL。

entries.title: Multi-step agent loop
entries.summary: 当前 AgentLoop.run() 与 AgentStreamLoop.stream() 都写死成两步形状，与 Claude Code 式多轮工具循环不兼容。将固定序列替换为 while 循环，支持多步 model→policy→tools→回灌直到 model 不再产生 toolCalls 或 budget 耗尽。

entries.title: Auto-compress context after final answer
entries.summary: Agent loop 在每次 final answer 后自动检查 token 阈值并触发压缩，补全 P1b 的最后一环。

entries.title: Session list management
entries.summary: 为 Frontend 增加多会话管理：列出 / 切换 / 删除 / 新建 session。

entries.title: MCP tool integration
entries.summary: 让 TS Agent Runtime 通过 MCP (Model Context Protocol) 集成外部工具服务器，扩展可用工具集而不增加 Java backend 的工具注册负担。

entries.title: MessageHistory Persistence + Context Compression
entries.summary: P0a/P0b 的 MessageHistory 是纯内存的，进程重启即丢失。生产环境需要持久化以支持长会话、多实例部署和故障恢复。同时引入 Insert-then-Compress 策略在后台压缩历史。

entries.title: Provider Adapter + Cache Hints
entries.summary: P0b 使用 SenseNova 硬编码调用。P1a 需要正式的 provider adapter 抽象，支持多 provider 切换（OpenAI-compatible / Anthropic），实现 cache hints 跨边界协议，并在 trace 中落地 cost/token 字段。

entries.title: Implement P0b Hookable
entries.summary: P0a 已验证双运行时边界和同步 agent loop。P0b 需要把 beforeToolUse hook、policy evaluate、SSE 流式、ask_user 审批流接上，使 harness 具备真正的不可绕过安全能力。

entries.title: Implement P0a Skeleton
entries.summary: OpenHarness needs a runnable first slice that proves the frozen architecture boundary across Frontend, TypeScript Agent Runtime, Java Spring Boot Backend, and shared contracts. Establish the monorepo skeleton and deterministic mock behavior.
